description.value: Wild Poppy Market is a dedicated 100% gluten-free bakery and café in the heart of historical downtown Ladysmith on Vancouver Island, founded by Chef Kate Cram. It offers house-made grab-and-go savoury meals, fresh daily baked goods, and a retail section stocking gluten-free staples sourced from local producers including Cowichan Milk Company and Farmer Ben's Eggs. Touring cyclists with gluten intolerance will find an unusually broad range of safe, ready-to-eat options alongside packaged goods they can carry onward.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wild Poppy Market is an active gluten-free bakery and café at 541 First Avenue, Ladysmith, BC with phone (250) 924-8696; address and website match OSM exactly. The menu page explicitly lists daily soups, quiche, breakfast sandwiches, and paninis supporting hot food, and the menu narrative states 'gluten free retail food products including baking ingredients, snacks, pastas, condiments, and much more' supporting basic groceries. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water access, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number recorded; (250) 924-8696 was found only on the website and has been used as the primary phone value.
OSM tag is shop=bakery but the candidate is categorised as Groceries; defensible given the retail food product range but worth noting for OSM tag quality.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bakery-café with confirmed address, phone, and website; offers retail food products and hot grab-and-go meals of clear value to touring cyclists, particularly those requiring gluten-free options.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business operates a small cafeteria-style seating area shared with the neighbouring Old Town Ice Cream suite. It is part of the 'Old Town Collective' alongside Old Town Bakery across the street, both connected to Chef Kate Cram.

Hot food.detail: Menu lists Daily Soup, Today's Quiche, breakfast sandwiches (Country Sausage Breakfast Sandwich, Breakfast Sandwich), breakfast wraps, and paninis — all items typically served hot and prepared in-house daily
